turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we'll use the time properly. My son saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class and nobody called me first: who decided that, and when?
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who entered that zero, and on what basis?
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. That's not why I'm here. The zero comes off and I get an apology, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
Write your own emails. You have eighteen minutes to show me why my son got a zero, or I go upstairs.
